entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s over a subquery wrapping a native-histogram-valued shape is unsupported
entries.rationale: the canonical range-function gate admits exactly the names recognized by chplan.IsPromQLRangeWindowFunc. For histogram-bearing rows, lowerHistogramOrMixedSubqueryOuterFnInput handles all SELECT/FOLD names and histogramSubqueryFloatOnlyDropFunc handles the remainder by returning an empty float result. That partition is exhaustive, so this trailing rejection is not wire-reachable.

guard: past returning if err := requireMixedPlanPolicy(inner, mixedSubqueryFamily); err != nil
past returning if node, matched, err := lowerHistogramOrMixedSubqueryOuterFnInput(inner, kind, outer.Func.Name, sub, s, ctx); matched
